owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

bid(uint256,uint256).notice: Direct bid. Draws from the bidder's claimable balance first (credit),         then pulls only the remainder from the bidder's USDC allowance.

bidWithAuthorization(uint256,uint256,uin.notice: Gasless bid. The bidder signs only the `topUp` portion.         `credit = amount - topUp` is deducted from `claimable[from]`.         `topUp == 0` reverts — credit-only bids must use direct `bid()`.

refundBuyer(uint256,string).notice: Refund the buyer with an optional reason. Callable by the seller.         Pushes payment directly to buyer's wallet (falls back to claimable if blocked).

submitEvidence(uint256,string).notice: Submit a short text evidence for an OFFCHAIN lot.         Only the buyer or the seller may call while escrow is HELD or DISPUTED.         At most MAX_EVIDENCE_PER_PARTY submissions per party per lot.
